nidalib.config.title: Nidalib
nidalib.config.blend_levels.tooltip: How many steps lava blends in at biome borders while shaders are on. More steps look smoother but use more texture memory. Changing it reloads resources.
nidalib.config.shader_blend.tooltip: How lava blends at biome borders while shaders are on. Dithering: a pixel pattern of the hotter color. Pre-Blend: the two colors mixed smoothly. Without shaders, lava always blends normally. Changing it reloads resources.
